name: Deepfury's Orders
summary: Beneath the Thandol Span, Deepfury's Orders lie with the fallen Ol' Rustlocke. The crumpled parchment carries grim instructions from the Dark Iron dwarves who ambushed the scouting defender.

sections.title: A Grasp Beneath the Span
sections.body: Ol' Rustlocke, a dwarven bridge defender, was scouting the foundations of the Thandol Span when Dark Iron dwarves cornered and slew him. Beside his clenched fist lay crumpled orders drafted by their leader, Deepfury. The parchment is direct proof of a coordinated plot against the bridge linking the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: Uncovering the Threat
sections.body: When the orders reach Rhag Garmason, they confirm the bridge garrison's worst suspicions. The Dark Iron dwarves have planned operations directly beneath the Thandol Span's stonework. Rhag calls for urgent reinforcements from Ironforge and Stormwind.

faq.answer: Deepfury's Orders are written military orders belonging to the Dark Iron commander Deepfury. They were found beside Ol' Rustlocke's corpse beneath the Thandol Span.
The crumpled parchment was found beside Ol' Rustlocke's clenched fist in the cavernous support structures beneath the Thandol Span in the northern Wetlands.
Ol' Rustlocke was a dwarven scout stationed at the Thandol Span. He went to investigate strange activity around the bridge supports and was ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves.

aliases: who do i bring orders to
faq.answer: Deepfury's Orders are brought to Rhag Garmason, the dwarven commander holding out at Dun Modr near the Thandol Span. He reads them to assess the Dark Iron threat.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the discovery of Dark Iron scheming beneath the Thandol Span cuts deep for Ironforge. The span is one of your kingdom's greatest engineering achievements and a vital northern trade link.
As an Alliance member, you see the intercepted orders expose a sabotage attempt against the primary overland artery linking Dun Morogh, the Wetlands, and the northern Alliance outposts.
